game.title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
game.blurb: Soulslike action RPG set in the Three Kingdoms era, from Team Ninja (Koei Tecmo), released 2023-03-03. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

Fandom (wolong.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://wolong.fandom.com/wiki/Wo_Long:_Fallen_Dynasty
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Achievements subpages are linked but not written (only a Table of Contents page exists). wolong.fandom.com answers the API, but its game page has only 7 links; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 57 of 90 Steam achievements are hidden. Hidden achievements listed in the Steam schema among the visible DLC ones (after "Tactical Prodigy") were assigned to the three expansions by their schema position and unlock rates; that split, and the cestus / long sword / whip kill achievements, is an inference and needs checking. The remaining hidden ones sit in the main story chapter.
